## Advisor angle
If more hikes are expected, advisors will likely get questions from clients about bond holdings and cash. Gold and stocks are both falling while rates rise, so clients may ask why their diversifiers aren't helping. An advisor would explain how rate expectations affect each asset and keep the conversation tied to the client's time horizon.

## Term of the day: Sector rotation
Investors sell one part of the market and buy another. Yahoo Finance ran a headline about consumer staples benefiting from a rotation as tech got slammed ([Yahoo Finance](https://news.google.?oc=5)).

## Interview talking point
"Today's tech selloff while the Fed signals more hikes shows why advisors stress diversification and explaining rate risk to clients."
